statement.p: Find the gradient of the function f(x,y,z) = 4xe^{\frac{y}{2}}\sin\mathopen{}\left(3z\right).

static.solution: f_x = 4e^{\frac{y}{2}}\sin\mathopen{}\left(3z\right), f_y = 4x\cdot 0.5e^{\frac{y}{2}}\sin\mathopen{}\left(3z\right), and f_z = 4xe^{\frac{y}{2}}\cdot 3\cos\mathopen{}\left(3z\right). Thus \mbox{grad} f = 4e^{\frac{y}{2}}\sin\mathopen{}\left(3z\right)\,\mathit{\vec i}+4x\cdot 0.5e^{\frac{y}{2}}\sin\mathopen{}\left(3z\right)\,\mathit{\vec j}+4xe^{\frac{y}{2}}\cdot 3\cos\mathopen{}\left(3z\right)\,\mathit{\vec k}.
